parsed.summary: Sprint 2 review shifted the program posture materially. The vendor delay became explicit, leadership directed the team to prioritize FHIR over feature work, and Dr. Sohl raised concern about insufficient integration-test readiness.

decisions.label: prioritize FHIR migration work
decisions.anchorText: FHIR migration work will take priority over all new feature work until the dependency risk is reduced.

decisions.label: defer three feature stories to Sprint 3
decisions.anchorText: Three feature stories will be deferred to Sprint 3 so engineering effort can stay aligned to the critical path.

decisions.label: plan integration test harness work for Sprint 3
decisions.anchorText: Integration test harness work must be planned explicitly for Sprint 3 rather than assumed as hidden labor.

warnings: Dr. Sohl raised concern about insufficient integration-test readiness.
Approval of a revised test schedule does not erase the environment risk.
